description: This Java class represents an Order entity within the web admin module of the sales management system, encapsulating order details, status, delivery, and billing information.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order with properties like ID, status list, purchase date, and embedded delivery and billing details.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date for the order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment related to the order's history.

methods.name: setOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Sets the comment related to the order's history.

methods.name: getOrderStatusList
methods.description: Returns the list of possible order statuses.

methods.name: setOrderStatusList
methods.description: Sets the list of order statuses.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the core order details from the model.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the core order details in the model.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the delivery details associated with the order.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery details for the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns the billing information for the order.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing information for the order.
